text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking hours be extended on the even (west) side of Mutual Street, between Gerrard Street East and Carlton Street, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Mutual Street to improve parking flexibility and to allow the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, to effectively control long-term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the October 24, 2024 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
